welcome.title: Your study buddy for tests and exams.
welcome.body: Tell Buddy when your next test is and photograph your worksheet. Buddy turns it into practice and keeps track of the dates for you.
welcome.reset_sent: If there is an account with this address, an e-mail to reset the password is on its way.
welcome.confirm_body: We sent you an e-mail. Tap the link in it, then sign in here.
welcome.minor_hint: Under 16? Then an adult sets up the account with their e-mail – best together with you, right now. It takes about a minute.

consent.title: A quick word on privacy
consent.intro: The key points in brief – for you or, if your child is the learner, for both of you:
consent.point_data: We store what is written in the chat with Buddy, the worksheets and how practice goes. That's the only way Buddy can help with learning.
consent.point_photos: We delete photos at the latest 7 days after Buddy has read them.
consent.point_ai: Buddy uses an AI by Google Cloud with servers in the EU.
consent.point_voice: When practising pronunciation, the AI listens to the recording. The recording is not stored.
consent.point_contact: Buddy only messages the phone if that is allowed. For under 16s, the parents allow it – with their PIN.
consent.point_control: Everything can be viewed, changed and deleted at any time.
consent.accept: I have read this and agree.
consent.parents_needed: Your parents need to agree here. Please hand them the phone so they can sign in again.

profile.title: Who is learning with LearnBuddy?
profile.name_child: What's your child's name? (A nickname is fine)
profile.birth_date_hint: So Buddy knows how old you are. Special rules apply for under 16s.
profile.birth_date_hint_child: So Buddy knows how old your child is. Under 16, you as parents decide on some settings.
profile.child_consent: I have parental responsibility and consent to my child's data being processed as described (GDPR Art. 8).
profile.pin_body: With this PIN you later allow, for example, that Buddy may message your child's phone. Your child shouldn't know it.
profile.pin_mismatch: The PINs don't match. Please try again.
profile.too_young_self: Under 16, an adult sets up the account with you. Is someone there right now? Then hand them the phone – your name and birth date stay filled in.
profile.parent_title: One more thing for the parents
profile.handover_email: The account uses the e-mail {{email}}. If that isn't your address, change it afterwards in the settings under "For parents" – otherwise whoever owns that e-mail can sign in there too.
profile.pin_forgot: Forgot the PIN? Set a new one in Settings under “For parents”.
profile.handover_pin: Parents' PIN: set – only you know it
profile.handover_contact: Messages to the phone: off. Buddy asks {{name}} once a test is coming up – only you can allow it, with the PIN.
profile.voice_body: Tap a voice to hear it. You can change it any time – in the settings, or just ask Buddy.
profile.voice_later: The voices can't be reached right now. You can pick one later in the settings.
profile.contact_optin: Buddy may write briefly – e.g. before a test. Never late, changeable any time.

pin.title: Parent PIN
pin.body: Only your parents can allow this. Hand them the phone for a moment.
pin.locked: Too many attempts. The PIN is locked for now – please try again later.
pin.not_set: There is no PIN yet. Your parents can set it in the settings.

purpose.contact: Your parents allow Buddy to write to you more. Hand them the phone for a moment.
purpose.export: For parents: export all data. Please enter the PIN.
purpose.delete: For parents: delete the account. Please enter the PIN.
purpose.cancel_deletion: For parents: cancel the planned deletion. Please enter the PIN.
purpose.credentials: For parents: change e-mail or password. Please enter the PIN.
purpose.profile: For parents: correct the name or birth date. Please enter the PIN.
purpose.consent: For parents: agree to the new privacy notice. Please enter the PIN.
purpose.parents: For parents: open the parents' area. Please enter the PIN.

pin.locked_until: Too many attempts. The PIN is locked until {{time}}.

reauth.title: Please confirm with your password
reauth.body: For security this needs your password.

error.invalid_credentials: E-mail or password is not right.
error.email_not_confirmed: Please confirm your e-mail address first.
error.weak_password: The password is too short or too simple.
error.already_registered: This e-mail is already registered. Sign in instead.
error.network: No connection. Try again in a moment.
error.same_password: That's the current password. Please choose a new one.
error.invalid_email: That e-mail address doesn't look right. Please check it again.
error.email_taken: There is already an account with this e-mail address.
error.reauth_needed: For security: please sign out once and sign in again. Then it will work.
error.session_expired: You're no longer signed in. Please sign in again.
error.link_invalid: This link no longer works. Just ask for a new one.
error.rate_limited: That was a few tries too many. Wait a moment, then try again.

new_password.mismatch: The two passwords don't match yet.

reset.title: A new password
reset.body: Choose a new password and enter it twice. You'll be signed in right after.
reset.saved: Done – your new password works from now on.
reset.invalid_body: Reset links only work for a short time and only once. No problem: just ask for a new one under “Forgot your password?” when signing in.
reset.offline_body: Checking the link needs the internet. Try again in a moment.
